decisions.reason: A multi-model lever handle family that stayed on the website while sibling launches were dropped has absorbed design and tooling investment and anchors the firm's core hardware offer, so management will hold onto it and treat weak sales as temporary, construction-cycle effects.

This single handle design survived the 2019 pruning that removed similar designs, which signals that management has already justified it; with low ongoing costs and sunk design effort, it stays in the range for now.

The electronic access system is central to the firm's announced move into digital building organization and is publicly tied to its strategy, so management will persist with it even if results disappoint.
